sources: Wikipedia page revision history [T0, sample]; List of Baseball Hall of Fame nominees with biographical and performance data [T0, sample]; Wikipedia page traffic data [T0, dependent]; University of Pennsylvania library, First Copyright Renewals for Periodicals [T0, key_independent]
rationale: Citations and traffic come from public Wikipedia archives, copyright status from a public UPenn list. Player data set is unnamed and its construction sits in Online Appendix A.3.

title: Exploring the Structure of Complex Software Designs: An Empirical Study of Open Source and Proprietary Code
authors: Alan MacCormack; John Rusnak; Carliss Y. Baldwin

title: How Much Did the Liberty Shipbuilders Forget?
sources: National Archives RG 178, Records of the Historian's Office (unit labor requirements, keel-laying dates, construction times, ways) [T0, sample]; Bureau of Labor Statistics forms BLS1761, Plant Operations (monthly hiring and separation rates) [T0, key_independent]

sources: USPTO patents and patent citations, application years 1975-2009 [T0, sample]; Lai et al. (2009) inventor city latitude and longitude data [T0, key_independent]; Core based statistical area (CBSA) definitions, U.S. OMB 2003 [T0, key_independent]; NBER technological category classification (Jaffe and Trajtenberg 2002) [T0, control]

title: Shifts of Reference Points for Framing of Strategic Decisions and Changing Risk-Return Associations
sources: COMPUSTAT [T2c, sample]
rationale: ROE time series for 1,343 firms in 14 two-digit SIC industries, 1972-1991, all from COMPUSTAT; no other source.

title: Gaining Comparative Advantage Through Discretionary Expenditures: The Returns to R&D and Advertising
sources: Standard and Poor's 1986 Compustat database [T2c, sample]; Japan Development Bank tapes [T2, robustness]; Japan Securities Research Institute tapes [T2, robustness]

title: What Do We Know About Variance in Accounting Profitability?
authors: Anita M. McGahan; Michael E. Porter
sources: Compustat Business-Segment reports [T2c, sample]

title: R&D/Returns Causality: Absorptive Capacity or Organizational IQ
sources: Compustat industrial annual file [T2c, sample]; Carnegie Mellon Survey (CMS) of R&D laboratories, industry list [T0, sample]; Patents granted to chemical firms by patent class, 1995–1999 (source not named) [T0, dependent]

title: Pioneering Inventors or Thicket Builders: Which U.S. Firms Use Continuations in Patenting?
authors: Deepak Hegde; David C. Mowery; Stuart J. H. Graham

rationale: USPTO patents 1981-2004 with continuation type, matched to Compustat firms through the NBER correspondence file. Multinomial logit. No proprietary source.

title: Does Diversification Create Value in the Presence of External Financing Constraints? Evidence from the 2007–2009 Financial Crisis
sources: Compustat Industry Segment database [T2c, sample]; Compustat (quarterly firm data) [T2c, dependent]; TED spread, commercial paper spread and VIX [T0, key_independent]; S&P credit ratings [T2c, key_independent]
rationale: Sample, excess values, leverage and segment investment all from Compustat and its segment file; crisis measured by TED spread and VIX. Providers of spreads and S&P ratings are not named.

title: Do Unions Affect Innovation?

title: To Lobby or to Petition: The Political Environment of U.S. Trade Policy
authors: Stefanie A. Lenway; Carol K. Jacobson; Judith Goldstein

title: Is the past prologue?: A test of Ghiselli's hobo syndrome
sources: National Longitudinal Surveys Youth Cohort (NLSY), 1979-1988 [T1, sample]
rationale: Event history analysis of NLSY79 work histories 1979-88, a public secondary survey. The 12% random subsample (n=1,530) can't be redrawn exactly.

title: Generational Differences in Work Values: Leisure and Extrinsic Values Increasing, Social and Intrinsic Values Decreasing
authors: Jean M. Twenge; Stacy M. Campbell; Brian J. Hoffman; Charles E. Lance
sources: Monitoring the Future [T1, sample]

title: A Multilevel Investigation of Individual- and Unit-Level Human Capital Complementarities
sources: Major League Baseball 2012 season records on pitchers, fielders and managers [T0, sample]; Pitch f/x pitch-tracking data, 2012 season [T0, key_independent]; Ultimate zone ratings (UZR) of team fielders [T0, key_independent]; Career winning records of head, bench, pitching and bullpen coaches [T0, key_independent]; MLB player draft records [T0, control]; 2012 team schedules and runs scored [T0, control]

title: Set Up to Fail: Explaining When Women-Led Businesses Are More Likely to Fail
authors: Tiantian Yang; María del Carmen Triana
sources: Panel Study of Entrepreneurial Dynamics II (PSED II) [T1, sample]; U.S. Census Bureau, percentage of women employees in an industry [T0, key_independent]

title: Organization Task Environments: Have they Changed Fundamentally over Time?
sources: US Census of Manufactures [T0, sample]
rationale: All data came from the US Census of Manufactures, 1967-1992. The 45 randomly drawn established industries are not listed, so the exact sample cannot be rebuilt.

title: Resetting the Shot Clock

sources: Sports Reference, LLC (NBA game logs, 2000-2009) [T0, sample]
rationale: All variables (shooting percentage, mobility events, controls) built from Sports Reference NBA game logs; public sports records, no other source.

title: Human Capital, Social Collaboration, and Patent Renewal Within U.S. Pharmaceutical Firms
sources: Compustat [T2c, sample]; COMETS database (Kauffman Foundation; Zucker, Darby, & Fong 2011) [T1, sample]; USPTO Patent Gazette (expired patents) [T0, dependent]

title: Almighty Dollar or Root of All Evil? Testing the Effects of Money on Workplace Behavior
authors: Jeremy M. Beus; Daniel S. Whitman

title: High-Involvement Management, Economic Recession, Well-Being, and Organizational Performance
sources: Britain's 2011 Workplace Employment Relations Survey (WERS), management and employee surveys [T1, sample]

authors: Stefan Arora-Jonsson; Filippo Carlo Wezel; Soorjith I Karthikeyan; Vitaliano Barberio

title: The Signaling Role of Politician Stock Ownership: Effects on Lobbying Intensity

title: Images in Words: Presidential Rhetoric, Charisma, and Greatness
authors: Cynthia G. Emrich; Holly H. Brower; Jack M. Feldman; Howard Garland
sources: U.S. presidents' inaugural addresses (electronic versions) [T0, sample]; Presidents' pivotal speeches (Study 2) [T0, sample]; Simonton (1988) presidential charisma and creativity scores [R, dependent]; Murray and Blessing (1983) presidential greatness ratings [R, dependent]; Smith et al. (2000) presidential greatness total score [R, dependent]; Martindale's Regressive Imagery Dictionary [T0, key_independent]; Toronto Word Pool (Friendly et al., 1982) [T0, robustness]

authors: Xavier Sobrepere i Profitós; Thomas Keil; Pasi Kuusela

sources: Correlates of War state system membership list (COW, 2008) [T0, sample]; IGO membership data (Wallace and Singer, 1970; Pevehouse, Nordstrom, and Warnke, 2004) [T0, sample]; Polity score (Marshall and Jaggers, 2005) [T0, key_independent]; Militarized Interstate Dispute (MID3) dataset (Ghosn, Palmer, and Bremer, 2004) [T0, key_independent]; Gleditsch (2002) dyadic trade data [T0, key_independent]; Direct-line distance between states [T0, key_independent]; NGO memberships coded by Hafner-Burton and Tsutsui (2005) [T0, key_independent]; IGO bureaucratic structure (Boehmer, Gartzke, and Nordstrom, 2004 coding scheme) [T0, control]; Global GDP estimates (Delong, 1998) [T0, control]
rationale: "We compiled our data from several publicly available sources": COW IGO and state lists, Polity, MID3, Gleditsch trade. Distance source unnamed; NGO data from another study.

title: Loyal to Whom? The Effect of Relational Embeddedness and Managers’ Mobility on Market Tie Dissolution
authors: Y. Sekou Bermiss; Bruce E. Greenbaum
sources: Texas Ethics Commission (TEC) lobbyist registration and activity reports [T0, sample]

title: State Agency Discretion and Entrepreneurship in Regulated Markets

title: Gender Gaps in Perceived Start-up Ease: Implications of Sex-based Labor Market Segregation for Entrepreneurship across 22 European Countries
authors: Vartuhi Tonoyan; Robert Strohmeyer; Jennifer E. Jennings

title: Technological Distance and Breakthrough Inventions in Multi-Cluster Teams: How Intra- and Inter-Location Ties Bridge the Gap
sources: Nanobank [T1, sample]; National Nanotechnology Infrastructure Network (NNIN) list of 13 clusters [R, sample]; Harvard Business School Patent Network Dataverse (Lai et al., 2011) [T0, key_independent]; NBER patent data technology subcategories (Hall, Jaffe, and Trajtenberg, 2001) [T0, key_independent]; COMETS (Zucker and Darby, 2011) [T1, control]
rationale: Patent teams, citations and cluster vectors come from Nanobank (USPTO patents), the Lai et al. inventor dataverse and COMETS; all public patent-derived data, no survey or proprietary source.

title: From Chaos to Systems: The Engineering Foundations of Organization Theory, 1879-1932
sources: Coverage of systems in the American Machinist, the Engineering Magazine and the ASME Transactions (author's page counts) [R, dependent]; ASME annual membership (ASME archive) [R, key_independent]; Strikes per year, U.S. Department of Labor (Peterson, 1938), with Griffin (1939) for 1906-1913 [R, key_independent]; Workers per strike, U.S. Department of Labor (Peterson, 1938) [R, control]; Share of items on management in the three periodicals (author's coding) [T0, control]; Historical Statistics of the United States (U.S. Department of Commerce, 1975) [T0, control]

title: Collaborative Brokerage, Generative Creativity, and Creative Success

title: Board Composition: Balancing Family Influence in S&P 500 Firms
